title: First Free Chat Response QA
principle: The first prompt must be useful without backend setup, honest about the fallback, and lead to one safe next action.
public_repo_rule: This report stores only response contracts and UI evidence. It contains no prompts, responses from users, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private content.

scenarios.intent: User opens chat and sends a first prompt before choosing a model.
expected_response_evidence: free browser guidance, not a remote LLM
scenarios.next_action: Press + Add model and run the free Local Node installer.

scenarios.intent: User asks how to connect or install a model.
scenarios.next_action: Open + Add model, then install/prove a local starter model.

scenarios.intent: User asks which free model to use first.
scenarios.next_action: Choose a free starter model from the model picker.

scenarios.intent: User asks how MMIR can earn money or scale to paying users.
scenarios.next_action: Keep the free local chat loop green before enabling premium routes.
